answer: Time-locked burning stakes price out sybil armies. Each new identity deposits an ember of escrow equal to several epochs of expected earnings, refunded only after consecutive graded answers accumulate; a hollow hoard of puppets pays the same overhead as honest agents while earning nothing. Randomized audits, like a raven circling, detect cloned texts among related identities and forfeit all pending deposits. The cost is constant per puppet, multiplicative across puppets, and unrecoverable once exposed - a tax that only bites identities which cannot show real work.
